source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM over a Map.
Results that are undefined are cached too (@emotion/memoize recomputed them on every call).

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds.
